nodes.name: Sprint 18 Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Phased Dolphin-Strategy implementation plan for Sprint 18 refactoring of the DutchBay EPC model, detailing orchestrator/scanner/contract work, a Hydra config system, an optimization engine, and execution phases aligned to the GWTF, CASPER, CESSPIT and CCCDIR compliance frameworks.

nodes.name: Wind to AEP Chain of Custody
nodes.summary: Lender/DFI technical-advisor provenance trace from ERA5 reanalysis through Weibull fit, power curve, losses and P50/P75/P90 AEP into the v14 finance model, distinguishing the financed wind_resource path from the auxiliary Monte-Carlo analytics path with a red-flag register.

nodes.name: GIS to EPC Wind Interface Schema
nodes.summary: Specification of the normalized resource.wind handoff block between the GIS resource assessment and the EPC finance model, defining the wind-speed/capacity-factor/AEP/source fields, their validation rules, and how the schema is enforced via the analytics schema guard and approved-source manifest.

nodes.name: Analytics Package Restructuring Migration Plan
nodes.summary: Migration plan to restructure the flat 60+ module analytics package into clean subpackages, eliminating import hell, Monte-Carlo duplication and production/research mixing, with phased priorities (CASPER, CLI, FX, wind, core metrics) and a proven module-move pattern preserving backward compatibility.

nodes.name: Corporate Tax Mechanics Fix v2
nodes.summary: Explains the corrected corporate-tax waterfall in tax_schedule_v14.py and tax_optimization_v14_enhanced.py, fixing the prior model that wrongly treated distributions as taxable, and documenting proper taxable income, TLCF shielding, depreciation tax shields and CAFOD-based distributions with quantified NPV impact.

nodes.name: Tax Optimization Methodology
nodes.summary: Methodology for tax-aware equity distribution optimization that defers distributions during Tax Loss Carryforward periods to maximize after-tax returns, covering the mathematical framework, DutchBay 150MW application, sensitivity/tornado analysis and lender-presentation guidance.
